operations.title: Ship the Rust-native, Relate-centered writ-relate application
operations.text: The hackathon workflow ships the Rust writ-relate CLI and read-only MCP server over an embedded Relate directory store. The Python grounded profiles remain historical reference material, not the shipping runtime.
operations.rationale: Owner product requirement; not a measured performance or accuracy win.

operations.text: Owner direction recorded 2026-11-14: the shipping application must be Python-free and centered on Relate; the Python-profile ADR remains historical evidence and does not dictate the new product implementation.
